name: simulate-batch
why: The four annual phases extracted in the simulate-batch slice, plus the sub-arms whose reach cannot be assumed. REPOINTED after the extractions landed: every range now names the extracted helper under projection/internal/, not the removed inlined block in projection/simulate.ts, and one entry (B.application) names the call site because that arm stayed there. Block D - income pass 1, wages - was REMOVED when this branch merged origin/main. That phase was extracted concurrently and independently on main as projection/internal/wageIncomeStreams.ts; this slice's duplicate helper was withdrawn rather than kept, and main's version is not this spec's to prove. The surviving ids A, B, C and E were left as they are rather than renumbered, so reach output stays comparable with the runs taken before the merge. All helper ranges were rechecked on this tree, while B.application is pinned to its current pension-credit branch by exact content anchors. The normal engine test suite now validates every committed reach-spec anchor and refuses any unanchored projection/simulate.ts range, so a later source shift fails before coverage can silently report unrelated code as reached.

readingTheCounts: 'members that reach it' counts corpus members whose peak line count inside the range is non-zero. V8 block coverage splits at braces and at branch bodies, not at every statement, so a range that is straight-line code after a `continue` inherits the enclosing block's count and OVER-reports. Entries that do are marked with a note. Cold regions do not have this problem: a zero-count range is an untaken branch, exactly.
